vehicleUpdates.headline: Roomy petrol option; exact mixed restraint fit pending
vehicleUpdates.summary: The original S 2.0 petrol uses a conventional six-speed automatic, rear vents and a full-size spare. Related GT-Line tests are encouraging, but the one-rear-facing plus two-other-seat arrangement still needs a fit check.

familyFit.summary: Related GT-Line trials succeeded with three forward-facing, three rear-facing, and two rear-facing seats plus a booster. The requested one-rear-facing plus two others was not established.
familyFit.testedSeats: Related 2022 GT-Line: three Infasecure Attain More forward-facing or three rear-facing; also two rear-facing Attain More plus an Aspire More booster. Reviewed photographs confirm those orientations.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Daily buckle access beside the requested mixed three-seat arrangement was not verified.
familyFit.access: BabyDrive found lifting a child in practical from inside or outside; this was GT-Line, not the S.

observedConsumption.basis: DiscoverAuto tested the exact 2022 S 2.0 petrol six-speed automatic in mixed driving. One road-test result; route, distance and refuelling method were not specified. Chasing Cars recorded 7.6 at launch on a different route. Neither is a fleet average.

safety.applicability: 2022 five-star NQ5 rating covers the 2.0 petrol automatic; expires December 2028. Selected capsule installations and one forward-facing centre convertible failed the Australian fit checks; this does not assess three seats together.

vehicleUpdates.servicing: 12 months / 15,000 km normally; severe-use oil services can shorten to 6 months / 7,500 km.
inspection: Fit one rear-facing seat plus the two other restraints, then check front-seat posture, tether routing and booster buckles.
Verify first-delivery date, all service invoices and any former rental or commercial use.
Check REC-005699 by VIN; test the 2.0 six-speed auto from cold and warm, and inspect oil level/history and timing-chain noise.
Quote the next major service: brake fluid every 2 years, severe-use transmission fluid at 90,000 km; check whether your short trips meet severe-use conditions.
gaps: No verified exact S-trim one-rear-facing plus two-other-seat test or daily booster buckle assessment.
No uncontaminated Australian NQ5 2.0 automatic owner aggregate or representative annual paid-repair dataset.
MY22 brochure verifies original core specifications; confirm later pre-facelift equipment and 2025 build/model-year by VIN.
No installed Australian exact-VIN engine or automatic-transmission repair quote was verified.

priceUpdates.geography: Three distinct QLD dealer vehicles: Hendra, Hillcrest and Hervey Bay
priceUpdates.note: Median of three exact S 2.0 petrol automatic asking prices, all advertised drive-away. Model/build years 2022–24 only; no 2025 observation. VINs deduplicated. Small sample and cached inventory: confirm price and availability. Sold Big Box U227948 and turbo/diesel/manual/facelift cars excluded.

ownershipUpdates.serviceInterval: 12 months / 15,000 km normally; severe-use oil services can shorten to 6 months / 7,500 km.
ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: A$500/year planning allowance retained. Kia lists seven normal 2.0 automatic visits at A$3,479 for 2022, A$3,331 for 2023 and A$3,344 for 2024. The 2022 year-four visit is A$759 and year-six A$706. Brake fluid is due every 2 years; engine coolant first 10 years/210,000 km and plugs at 150,000 km. Severe short-trip/stop-start use can require oil every 6 months/7,500 km and automatic fluid at 90,000 km. Budget depends on start age/km; later uncapped work needs a VIN quote.
warrantyCautions: Seven years/unlimited km for eligible private use starts at original delivery/registration, not your used purchase; transfer the owner record.
Any commercial use, including rental or rideshare, can limit the original warranty to 7 years/150,000 km.
Shorter terms apply: original 12V battery 2 years, original audio/navigation head unit 3 years; tyre wear and scheduled maintenance are separate.
Use the vehicle’s original contract and service records. Current EV or facelift terms do not define the old S petrol contract.

risks.title: Seat-belt warning recall
risks.detail: REC-005699: selected 2022–23 NQ5 VINs need instrument-cluster software correction. The separate 1.6 T-GDI fuel-pipe recall REC-006373 does not apply to this 2.0 MPi powertrain.
risks.priceBasis: Applicable recall software remedy is free; not an annual paid repair. Check all open campaigns by VIN.
risks.warranty: Recall remedy is separate from ordinary warranty expiry.

risks.title: Oil use, cold-start noise and automatic shift quality
risks.detail: ReDriven’s NQ5 review distinguishes the 2.0 naturally aspirated engine and six-speed auto from the troublesome turbo/DCT reports. It suggests checking oil consumption, chain rattle and auto shudder/slip; it supplies no failure rate or installed bill.
risks.priceBasis: Diagnosis and exact-VIN installed quote required. No representative Australian repair-price or failure-frequency dataset verified.
risks.warranty: Eligible manufacturing defects may be covered by remaining warranty; neglect, ordinary wear and ineligible history require assessment.

risks.title: 12V battery or original multimedia after shorter coverage
risks.detail: These components do not automatically receive the full seven-year base coverage. Test the battery and phone/media functions, especially on a 2022 used car.
risks.priceBasis: No exact S installed replacement quote verified; obtain a VIN-specific quote if faulty.
risks.warranty: Current Kia terms specify 2 years for original 12V battery and 3 years for the original audio/navigation head unit; confirm the original contract.

fuelEstimate.basis: Analyst family-driving estimate retained at 9.5 L/100km, scenarios 8.1–12. Exact S automatic road tests vary: DiscoverAuto 10.2 in mixed driving and Chasing Cars 7.6 at launch. Official 8.1 combined/11.0 urban are laboratory figures. No matched fleet average or representative urban-family result; replace after your own usage.

reviewUpdates.scope: Exact NQ5 2.0 naturally aspirated automatic aggregate not verified.
reviewUpdates.summary: ProductReview displays NQ5 petrol 3.5/5 from six, but includes a plainly labelled 2019 QL review and a GT-Line turbo/DCT failure. The aggregate is excluded from scoring; exact S road-test verdicts appear separately.
positiveThemes: A scoped SX owner reports comfort and handling; this is one anecdote, not a reliability measure.
negativeThemes: One SX owner reports intrusive assistance; misfiled older-generation and turbo/DCT complaints cannot define S 2.0 reliability.

expertReviews.tested: 2022 Sportage S 2.0 petrol FWD six-speed automatic
expertReviews.scope: Exact launch configuration; one professional test, not an owner-reliability survey. Later pre-facelift equipment needs VIN confirmation.
expertReviews.verdict: Strong ride and cabin space; weak performance, thirsty mixed-test consumption and expensive servicing.
negativeThemes: Modest acceleration and 10.2 L/100km in this mixed test.
Service costs and basic S equipment.

insuranceUpdates.basis: Rounded planning proxy from Youi national mixed-year/model comprehensive mean A$1,175, policies sold 22 November 2025–22 May 2026. Not an exact trim/year or Queensland household quote. The published 80%-within-or-below band is not a confidence interval; displayed wider scenarios are analyst budgets. Replace with a personal quote.

tyreUpdates.basis: Four Michelin Primacy 5 235/65R17 108V XL at A$329 each = A$1,316. JAX includes fitting, balancing, valves, waste handling and GST; alignment extra. Original base/S brochures specify 235/65R17. Confirm placard, wheel size, load/speed index and local stock. Set bounds and tyre life are assumptions, not measured model averages.

repairReserveUpdates.basis: A$850/year analyst repair savings fund retained, not a measured annual bill or failure probability. Original 2.0 MPi/six-speed cars avoid transferring turbo/DCT, diesel/DPF or older-generation engine claims. Age, history and remaining warranty matter more than an unsupported brand average. Includes diagnosis and age-related chassis, cooling and electrical contingencies; excludes scheduled service, tyres and insured collisions. Claim eligible warranty/recalls first; one major failure can exceed the fund. No representative Australian paid-repair dataset was verified.

fuelUpdates.basis: Kia NQ5 MY22 non-turbo manual recommends at least 91 RON outside Europe; exact Australian S 2.0 automatic test confirms 91 RON. Use the original handbook/fuel flap.

fitAssessments.summary: GT-Line three-across trials are promising. They demonstrate different facing combinations, not the exact one-rear-facing plus two-other-seat target. Your fit check remains pending.

arrangement.detail: Photos show three forward-facing Attain More, three rear-facing Attain More, or two rear-facing Attain More plus an Aspire More booster. No verified one-rear-facing plus two-forward-facing/booster trial in S. ANCAP also found selected capsule/centre-seat incompatibilities.

buckles.detail: No verified daily booster-buckle access test for the target arrangement.

space.detail: In the related GT-Line, BabyDrive accommodated a 180 cm driver or 186 cm front passenger ahead of a rear-facing Attain More. S trim and your seat geometry still need confirmation.

access.detail: BabyDrive found loading a child practical from inside or outside the related GT-Line. Three rear tethers were accessible through the boot; there is no third row.

audit.summary: Confirmed original 2.0 MPi/six-speed specifications, scheduled fluid work and component warranty limits. Added a third distinct QLD asking price and a second exact S road test. The requested mixed restraint arrangement and clean owner aggregate remain unverified; repair savings stay an explicit estimate.

items.finding: Three distinct 2022–24 QLD S petrol autos advertise A$25,990–28,999 drive-away, median A$27,980, 33,673–62,566 km. Small cached asking sample; sold stock excluded. No 2025 observation.
Original 2.0 MPi FWD six-speed auto: 8.1 L/100km ADR combined, 11.0 urban; 91 RON minimum. Exact road tests returned 7.6 and 10.2; the 9.5 planning figure remains an estimate. No plug-in hardware.

Related GT-Line fits three forward-facing, three rear-facing, or two rear-facing plus booster. Exact one-rear-facing plus two others and booster buckles remain unverified. ANCAP flags selected capsule and centre-convertible failures.

Seven years/unlimited km private use from original start, transferable; any commercial history can impose 150,000 km cap. Original 12V battery 2 years and multimedia 3 years. Check the vehicle’s original contract.

Normal 12 months/15,000 km; severe-use oil 6 months/7,500 km and auto fluid 90,000 km. Brake fluid 2 years, coolant initially 10 years/210,000 km, plugs 150,000 km. A$500/year retained; normal first-seven totals vary by year.
A$1,180 annual planning point retained from Youi’s mixed-year Sportage A$1,175 national mean. Not an exact S/QLD household quote; public premium band is not a confidence interval.
Original S uses 235/65R17. Four Michelin Primacy 5 at A$329 fitted including GST = A$1,316. Alignment extra; assumed 45,000 km life is unmeasured. Confirm placard and local stock.

A$850 repair fund retained, with no credible annual paid-repair average. Free cluster recall is not paid maintenance. Exclude turbo/DCT, diesel and old-generation faults; installed major-component prices remain quote gaps.
Wheels 7.3/10 and DiscoverAuto 8/10 test exact S petrol auto. ProductReview’s 3.5/5 from six contains a 2019 QL and turbo/DCT complaints, so no owner aggregate is scored.

543 L VDA boot, 4,660×1,865 mm body, rear vents and full-size spare verified. Braked tow 1,650 kg, towball 100 kg; not the manual/diesel 1,900 kg. 2022 five-star rating expires Dec 2028. QLD four-cylinder private rego/CTP A$864.50–880.50.
